description: Renovate proposes new versions as pull requests. All open updates: issue 'Dependency Dashboard'. Runs daily as a GitHub Action (.github/workflows/renovate.yml), no schedule window. Nothing is merged automatically – a merge to main goes live immediately. After every update 'pnpm dedupe' removes duplicate package copies from the lockfile (otherwise e.g. the drizzle-orm types stop matching).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Updates that fix a known vulnerability: right away, without schedule or waiting period

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh the lockfile once a month – picks up fixed sub-dependencies that would otherwise stay on old versions. The whole first week of the month, so a failed run does not miss the date

packageRules.description: Small fixes grouped in one pull request
New features grouped in one pull request
Major version jumps only as a checkbox in the Dependency Dashboard – the pull request is created once you tick it there
Node.js image (Dockerfiles) on its own instead of in the grouped PR, so security releases stand out; only long-term support versions (even major versions)
